session_note: North Dakota holds no regular session in 2026 -- its biennial regular session convened January 7, 2025 and adjourned sine die on Saturday, May 3, 2025 (confirmed at ndlegis.gov/assembly/69-2025/regular); a brief 2026 special session (Jan 21-23, 2026) was called only for Rural Health Transformation Program funding and did not touch these bills. Both packet bills are 2025-session bills; ND does not carry unpassed bills forward across bienniums, so any bill not enacted by the May 3, 2025 adjournment died with that session and does not resume in 2027.
